name: maizemeals-app
description: Here is a professional, complete `README.md` tailored to your specific stack (Next.js Monorepo + Python Scraper + Supabase).

scripts.db:pull-prod: npx dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'npx supabase db dump --db-url "$PROD_DB_URL" -f supabase/schema.sql && npx supabase db reset'
scripts.gen:types: npx dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'mkdir -p web/types && npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" --schema public > web/types/supabase.ts'
